sol.label: Edit profile
sol.detail: The check beside Default stays inside the highlighted tile when the menu opens.

sol.label: Outside the diagram
sol.detail: Hovering Back button fills marker 2 and outlines its matching card. The extra control gets a separate row with its own edit affordance.

sol.label: Gesture button tap
sol.detail: Win and Tab appear as separate keycaps beside Task View, with Edit aligned at the right.

sol.label: Choose an action to assign now
sol.detail: The Thumb buttons crop puts an amber 2 at the physical Back button, and the same number labels the editor.

sol.label: No matching actions
sol.detail: The no-results dialog centers its message above Clear search and Record a keyboard shortcut.

sol.label: Switch between two pointer speeds
sol.detail: The DPI editor places the two number fields next to their sliders and spells out Current and Next press above Save.

sol.label: Keyboard shortcut
sol.detail: The recording panel switches to Press a key, while the compact editor keeps all four checked modifiers and the complete chord visible.

sol.label: Ignore accidental nudges
sol.detail: The slider shows 50% of a notch in amber. The simpler state preserves that value in the high-resolution scrolling description.

sol.label: Gesture recognition off
sol.detail: The arrows lose their accent while the edit pencils stay amber, and the off-state copy says the actions remain editable.

sol.label: Pick a window
sol.detail: The capture row puts a six-second extension beside Cancel. After capture, comet.exe appears as a chip beside preview.exe, and a confirmation names Preview app.

sol.label: Reported mouse features
sol.detail: The connected view pairs a green battery bar with its percentage. The disconnected card offers Edit button mappings immediately below.

sol.label: HID++ features
sol.detail: The amber monospace IDs align in two columns, while unnamed IDs wrap into smaller chips beside a dedicated copy action.

sol.label: Remapping paused
sol.detail: The paused chip remains after the alert is dismissed. The compact shortcut editor puts Applies after resume next to Save shortcut.

sol.label: Start with Windows
sol.detail: A check sits in the left gutter, and horizontal rules separate Open mouse settings and Quit from the other controls.

terra.label: Buttons
terra.detail: The sidebar highlights Buttons, while Edit profile shows Default and a two-option profile menu.

terra.label: Buttons
terra.detail: Numbered markers connect MX Master artwork to assignment cards, with an Outside the diagram row for Button 0x01FF.

terra.label: Buttons
terra.detail: The compact list pairs each button with an action, keycaps, and an Edit button.

terra.label: Back button
terra.detail: The editor puts a Thumb buttons crop beside categories, action rows, and shortcut labels.

terra.label: No matching actions
terra.detail: Search for Copy returns one row with Ctrl and C keycaps; an empty search offers Clear search and Record a keyboard shortcut.

terra.label: Wheel mode button
terra.detail: Mouse actions offers Switch wheel mode and Switch pointer speed, followed by a two-speed DPI editor.

terra.label: Keyboard shortcut
terra.detail: Recording changes New shortcut to Press a key, then shows the captured key and Save shortcut; saved state shows K.

terra.label: Scroll
terra.detail: Wheel mode uses three radio cards, with Flick sensitivity and Ignore accidental nudges sliders and switches below.

terra.label: Gestures
terra.detail: Tap and four directional swipe rows show icons, keycaps, assigned actions, and edit pencils.

terra.label: Profiles
terra.detail: Numbered profile cards include application chips, Pick a window, reordering controls, and Delete profile.

terra.label: Device
terra.detail: Connection and firmware cards sit above battery, pointer speed, and reported mouse features.

terra.label: HID++ features
terra.detail: Named feature IDs form two columns, and 18 unnamed feature IDs appear as chips with a copy button.

terra.label: Remapping paused
terra.detail: A persistent title-bar status offers Resume; errors show retry and tray instructions, and successful resume turns green.

terra.label: Open mouse settings
terra.detail: The native tray menu shows Pause remapping or Resume remapping, Start with Windows, and Quit Mushak.

astra.label: Buttons / Edit profile
astra.detail: 01/03-Dark-menu.webp places the checked Default choice beside Preview app beneath the profile selector. The amber navigation rail, large Buttons heading and persistent battery card make the shell easy to scan.

astra.label: Buttons / Outside the diagram
astra.detail: 02/11-Dark-marker-hover.webp links the amber number 2 on the mouse to an outlined Back button card. The MX Master 4 frames add a sixth Haptic Sense Panel marker, and 17-Dark-named-button.webp shows Spare button below Outside the diagram.

astra.label: Buttons / Configure gestures
astra.detail: 03/05-native-compact-Dark-buttons.webp fits five mapping rows in the compact window, with Ctrl and W keycaps beside Close tab and a consistently placed Edit button at the right.

astra.label: Back button / Actions
astra.detail: 04/03-Dark-category-menu.webp highlights System in the left category column and aligns Task View and desktop actions with their shortcuts. The neighboring Thumb buttons crop shows the precise physical button.

astra.label: No matching actions
astra.detail: 05/04-Light-no-results.webp centers a search icon above No matching actions and offers Clear search beside Record a keyboard shortcut. The successful Copy result uses separated Ctrl and C keycaps.

astra.label: Wheel mode button / Switch pointer speed
astra.detail: 06/04-Light-dpi-editor.webp aligns Speed 1 and Speed 2 numeric fields with sliders, states the 200 to 4000 DPI range, and explicitly shows Current: 1000 DPI and Next press: 800 DPI above the save button.

astra.label: Keyboard shortcut / Assigned now
astra.detail: 07/09-Dark-draft-actions.webp labels Keyboard shortcut as Draft and warns that choosing an action discards draft M. 23-Dark-compact-chord.webp keeps all four selected modifiers and Space readable in the short window.

astra.label: Scroll / Ignore accidental nudges
astra.detail: 08/01-Dark-scroll.webp distinguishes the selected SmartShift card with an amber radio and border. The nudge slider shows 50% of a notch, while 07-native-compact-Dark-wheel.webp stacks the wheel choices cleanly.

astra.label: Gestures / Minimum swipe distance
astra.detail: 09/07-native-compact-Dark-gestures.webp fits Tap and four arrow-marked swipe rows above the distance slider. The 60 counts value has a concrete explanation of about 1.5 mm at 1000 DPI.

astra.label: Profiles / Pick a window
astra.detail: 10/15-native-compact-Dark-long-profile.webp wraps Move up, Move down and Delete profile beneath Photo editing and color correction without truncating its name. The capture state shows a six-second countdown and an extension button.

astra.label: Device / Reported mouse features
astra.detail: 11/09-native-compact-Dark-device.webp groups Bluetooth and firmware in paired cards, then shows a green 50% battery bar and amber 1000 DPI value. Disconnected frames offer Edit button mappings.

astra.label: HID++ features / 18 unnamed features
astra.detail: 12/02-Light-diagnostics.webp separates named features in two columns from compact hexadecimal chips for unnamed features. Copy device report and Copy unnamed IDs have distinct positions beside the relevant content.

astra.label: Remapping paused / Resume unconfirmed
astra.detail: 13/39-native-resume-Light-08-resume-failed.webp keeps the paused badge and Retry action in the title bar while showing tray recovery instructions below. 18-Light-resume-compact-editor.webp places Applies after resume next to Save shortcut.

astra.label: Open mouse settings / Resume remapping
astra.detail: 14/02-Windows-tray-paused.webp uses a native menu with Resume remapping, a checked Start with Windows item and a separator before Quit Mushak.
